title: SAP Technical Consultant
jobDescription: Job Description: SAP Technical Consultant (SAP BTP & S/4HANA Public Cloud) will design, build, and deploy cloud applications and integrations on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. The role focuses on clean core aligned extension development, modern cloud-native engineering practices, and end-to-end automation using CI/CD to enable reliable, repeatable delivery. The consultant will work across SAP and non-SAP landscapes, leveraging BTP services to deliver secure, scalable solutions. Key responsibilities: • Design and develop extensions on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry) using CAP and SAP HANA Cloud. • Build clean core–compliant extensions for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud (side-by-side / in-app as applicable) with strong governance around extensibility. • Model and implement data structures and services using CDS and expose/consume APIs (OData/REST). • Integrate SAP and third-party systems using SAP Integration Suite, Event Mesh, destinations, and APIs. • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment workflows across environments. • Apply security best practices: authentication/authorization, secure coding, and identity lifecycle management using IAS/IPS. • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize applications for performance, reliability, and scalability using SAP BTP tooling. Required technical skills: • Strong hands-on experience with build automation and DevOps practices in SAP/cloud environments. • Deep expertise in SAP BTP services, including Cloud Foundry, CAP, and SAP HANA Cloud. • Proven experience with clean core development principles for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. • Strong CDS modeling skills. • Proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript (preferred) or Python for cloud application development on BTP. • Experience with SAP Fiori/UI5 and integration with backend services via OData and REST. • Experience connecting CAP applications with SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA Cloud, and third-party systems using destinations and APIs. • Working knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and Event Mesh; Groovy scripting experience for complex integration scenarios. • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or SAP CI/CD services). • Familiarity with cloud-native development concepts (12-factor apps, configuration via environment, stateless services, scaling patterns). Additional skills: • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design (REST/OData). • Proficiency with Git-based workflows and version control practices. • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. • Ability to proactively monitor and improve system performance and operational stability.

title: SAP S/4HANA Solution Architect – Technical

The ideal candidate should possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA architecture, ABAP on HANA, RAP, Fiori, integrations, and end-to-end technical solution design across business functions. Design scalable, secure, and high-performance SAP solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. Lead technical architecture discussions across SAP modules, custom developments, integrations, and extensions. Provide architectural guidance on ABAP on HANA, RAP, CDS, Fiori/UI5, BTP, and integration patterns. Design and review custom objects, APIs, extensions, workflows, and side-by-side architectures. Drive solution design for SAP Public Cloud / Private Cloud / Hybrid landscapes. Collaborate with functional consultants, business stakeholders, and project managers for technical solutioning. Define development standards, coding best practices, and technical governance processes. Lead performance optimization, code remediation, and system scalability initiatives. Review technical specifications, development quality, transport strategy, and deployment approach. Support estimation, technical risk assessment, and architecture review boards. Knowledge of AI/ML use cases in SAP ecosystem is an advantage. SAP certification in S/4HANA / BTP / Architecture is preferred. SAP Certifications preferred

Minimum 3+ end-to-end RAP project implementations. Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Public Cloud / ABAP Cloud development. Expertise in CDS Views (Basic, Composite, Consumption). Strong knowledge of RAP Managed / Unmanaged scenarios. Experience in Behavior Definition, Behaviour Implementation, and Service Definition / Binding. Hands-on experience in EML (Entity Manipulation Language). Strong knowledge of Fiori Elements and OData exposure via RAP. title: Platform Engineer
jobDescription: Role Objective We are seeking a talented Platform Engineer with extensive experience in designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native platforms at scale. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, possess deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and have hands-on experience with observability platforms for monitoring, alerting, and operational insights. Knowledge or interest in AI-enabled development is a significant advantage as we strive for innovation in our engineering ecosystem. title: Automation Engineer
jobDescription: Role Objective We are seeking a detail-oriented Automation / Documentation Engineer with experience in developing and maintaining operational documentation, infrastructure automation artifacts, and standardized deployment processes. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience creating runbooks, change templates, validation scripts, and supporting Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) initiatives. This role requires strong documentation, scripting, and collaboration skills to improve operational efficiency, consistency, and automation across engineering teams. Roles & Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and update operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical documentation. Create and manage standardized change templates to support infrastructure and platform change management processes. Develop and maintain validation scripts to verify deployment readiness, configuration accuracy, and operational health. Provide support for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) implementations, including documentation, validation, and operational assistance. Collaborate with platform, cloud, and DevOps teams to standardize operational workflows and automation practices. Ensure documentation remains accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with infrastructure and application changes. Assist in improving operational efficiency by identifying opportunities for automation and process optimization. Participate in deployment planning, change reviews, and post-implementation validation activities. Maintain version control for documentation, scripts, and automation artifacts. Support knowledge-sharing initiatives by creating clear and comprehensive technical documentation for internal teams. Requirements Primary Skillsets Runbooks: Experience creating, maintaining, and improving operational runbooks for infrastructure, platform, and production support activities. Change Templates: Hands-on experience developing standardized change templates to support structured and compliant change management processes. Validation Scripts: Ability to create and maintain validation scripts to verify infrastructure deployments, configurations, and operational readiness. Terraform Support: Familiarity with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code, including supporting deployments, validating configurations, and maintaining related documentation. Secondary Skillsets Experience with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python is an advantage. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation practices. Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and DevOps methodologies is desirable. Knowledge of ITIL processes or change management practices is a plus. Relevant Experience Minimum 4+ years of experience in automation engineering, infrastructure documentation, DevOps support, or a related role. Experience supporting Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and operational automation initiatives. Strong documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with platform, cloud, and operations teams. Relevant certifications in cloud technologies, Terraform, or DevOps practices are preferred.

title: Cloud Network Engineer
jobDescription: Role Objective We are seeking a skilled Cloud Network Engineer with expertise in designing, implementing, and managing secure, scalable cloud networking solutions on Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with cloud networking services, routing, NAT, DNS, Application Gateway (or equivalent), and Kubernetes networking (AKS or GKE). The role requires a strong understanding of cloud network architecture, connectivity, security, and troubleshooting to support enterprise-grade environments. Roles & Responsibilities Design, implement, and manage cloud networking infrastructure on Azure or GCP. Configure and maintain virtual networks, subnets, routing, DNS, NAT, firewall rules, and network security components. Deploy, configure, and optimize Azure Application Gateway (or equivalent cloud load balancing solutions). Configure and manage networking for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or equivalent Kubernetes platforms. Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, DNS resolution, and application access issues in cloud environments. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to implement secure and scalable network architectures. Monitor network performance and recommend improvements to ensure high availability, security, and reliability. Ensure cloud networking solutions comply with organizational security standards and best practices. Document network architecture, configurations, and operational procedures. Requirements Primary Skillsets Cloud Networking (Azure or GCP): Hands-on experience with networking services in either Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. Routing & NAT: Strong understanding of IP routing, route tables, NAT configuration, and network traffic management. DNS: Experience configuring and troubleshooting cloud-based DNS services. Application Gateway / Load Balancing: Hands-on experience with Azure Application Gateway or equivalent cloud-native load balancing solutions. Kubernetes Networking: Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or similar managed Kubernetes platforms, including ingress, networking, and service connectivity. Secondary Skillsets Knowledge of hybrid connectivity solutions such as VPN or dedicated cloud connectivity. Familiarity with cloud network security concepts, firewalls, and Zero Trust principles. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar) is an added advantage. Exposure to cloud monitoring and network troubleshooting tools. Relevant Experience Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in cloud networking. Experience designing and supporting enterprise cloud network infrastructures on Azure or GCP. Relevant cloud certifications such as AZ-700, AZ-104, or Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer are preferred. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
